fusions.name: Swaddle
fusions.desc: Throws cloth that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Hindered] for 5 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Smothering Drape
fusions.desc: Drops a heavy drape over every enemy within 3 tiles, which deals 12 damage and leaves them [Damped] for 8 seconds, their damage lowered. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Tuck In
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to the ally who needs it most, for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Cocoon Reflex
fusions.desc: Once your health falls below 30%, a shield worth 25% of your maximum health wraps you for 6 seconds. Once every 45 seconds.
